title: Other records: Johnny Dodds, Nat Dominique, O'Brien, Blythe, Ma Rainey
summary: Asked about other recordings, he recalls Dodds on a Lil date, working with Dominique, and a date with Jimmy O'Brien that may have been Blythe's with Ma Rainey.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
